title: 《高等微積分》第 3 集｜函數、映射與合成｜Loomis & Sternberg 第 0 章 §7-9
description:
本集對應 Loomis 與 Sternberg《Advanced Calculus》第 0 章第 7 到 9 節（書頁 10 到 15），也是第 0 章的最後一集。

函數是一種特別的關係：定義域裡的每一個 x，恰好只配上一個值域元素 y。人們傾向把函數看成主動的、把不是函數的關係看成被動的——函數作用在 x 上給出一個值，所以也常被叫做算子。

如果 f 是函數，它的反關係一定是關係，但通常不是函數。平方就是書上的例子：它的反關係同時含有四配二與四配負二這兩對，所以不是函數。反關係也是函數的那種 f，就叫做一對一。

「從 A 到 B 的函數」這個記法隱含三件事：f 是函數、f 的定義域正好是 A、而且 f 的值域包含於 B。很多人覺得函數本來就該包含這三樣，也就是該看成 f、A、B 這個有序三元組，其中 B 叫做上域。書上把映射與變換這些詞留給這個三元組。一個映射如果是一對一的就叫嵌射，值域正好等於上域就叫滿射，兩者都成立就叫雙射。

接著是積集合與指標記法。現代數學有個習慣：一種新對象一出現，馬上就去看所有這種對象所成的集合。子集對應到特徵函數，取值只有零與一。有序三元組通常定義成前兩個先配成對、再與第三個配對，理由是兩個變數的函數通常被看成單一個有序對變數的函數。這種把其實不同的兩個對象視為同一的含糊，是為了精確而付出的必要代價。指標集合也一樣：一個加了指標的集合，其實就是那個指標函數；一般的笛卡兒積就由此定義。

最後是合成。g 與 f 的合成把 x 送到 g 括號 f 括號 x，這大概是數學裡最基本的二元運算，而且滿足結合律。恆等映射把每個元素送回自己，而一個映射有反映射，若且唯若它是雙射。

本影片為雙語教學動畫系列（繁體中文版）。

title: Advanced Calculus, Episode 3 | Functions, Mappings and Composition | Ch. 0, §7-9
description:
This episode covers chapter 0, sections 7 to 9 (pages 10 to 15) of Loomis and Sternberg's Advanced Calculus, finishing chapter 0.

A function is a special kind of relation: each element x of the domain is paired with exactly one range element y. One tends to think of a function as active and a relation that is not a function as passive; a function acts on x to give a value, so it is often called an operator.

If f is a function its relational inverse is certainly a relation, but in general not a function. Squaring is the book's example: its inverse contains both four paired with two and four paired with minus two, so it is not a function. An f whose inverse is a function is called one-to-one.

The notation f from A to B implies three things: that f is a function, that its domain is exactly A, and that its range is included in B. Many feel a function should include all of this, that is, be the ordered triple f, A, B, where B is called the codomain. The book keeps the words map, mapping and transformation for that triple. A mapping is injective if it is one-to-one, surjective if its range equals the codomain, and bijective if both.

Then product sets and index notation. A habit of the modern mathematician: once a new object appears, look at the set of all such objects. Subsets correspond to characteristic functions taking only zero and one. An ordered triple is usually defined as the first two paired, then paired with the third, because a function of two variables is read as a function of one ordered pair variable. This blurring, identifying objects that are really distinct, is a necessary price for deciding exactly what things are. Indexed sets are the same: an indexed set is really just the indexing function, and the general Cartesian product is defined from that.

Finally composition. The composition of g with f sends x to g of f of x. It is perhaps the basic binary operation of mathematics, and it is associative. The identity map sends each element to itself, and a mapping has an inverse exactly when it is bijective.

Part of a bilingual animated teaching series (English edition).
